title: MindGrow Stories
subtitle: Full-Stack AI Application
description: MindGrow Stories is a cloud-native AI platform that helps parents create personalized, educational children’s books designed to support learning, emotional development, and everyday parenting challenges through coordinated language, image-generation, and visual-quality workflows.
impact: Demonstrates end-to-end delivery of a cloud-native generative-AI product, combining multi-agent orchestration, multimodal generation, automated quality assessment, character-consistency controls, and CI/CD-based deployment.

title: Wizarding Story Engine
subtitle: Open-Source Multi-Agent Writing System
description: An AI-driven novel writing system that develops story ideas into complete chapters. It plans the narrative, writes scenes, checks characters and continuity, and revises the prose through repeated review cycles. Human approval remains part of the process, allowing each chapter to be accepted, revised, or redirected before the story continues.
impact: Demonstrates a modular, stateful reference architecture for controllable long-form generation, combining short- and long-term memory, specialized critic agents, iterative revision routing, checkpointed and resumable execution, human approval gates, and explicit token-usage and cost monitoring.
